latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor with AI Captions.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) to auto-generate and burn in subtitles using cloud AI.
- Supports fast 1080p MP4 exports, typically within 30-90 seconds.
- Manages sessions, free credits, file uploads, caption language options, and rendering workflow.
- Works for YouTubers and social media creators; best with clear audio.
- Guides you through upload, edit (caption, BGM, overlays), export, and download workflows.
- Handles errors and status updates, with clear platform integration details.
